en.name: Naver Flights
en.summary: Without signing in, Dool2 compares domestic flights across airlines at once and picks the cheapest or the time you want.

example.ask: Find the cheapest flight from Gimpo to Jeju on the 15th next month
example.reply: The cheapest Gimpo→Jeju flight on 12/15 is Jin Air at 06:05, special fare 34,200 won.
